segments.text: What if Naruto's shadow clones went on strike? Congratulations, bro got canceled by his own unpaid staff.
segments.label: THE CLONES HAVE DEMANDS

segments.text: In this alternate timeline, two hundred Narutos cross their arms. Same face. Same trauma. Terrifying customer service department.
segments.label: TWO HUNDRED IDENTICAL COMPLAINTS

segments.text: He says, we're literally the same person. Exactly, boss. We know you were about to volunteer us again.
segments.label: THE ORIGINAL IS CONFUSED

segments.text: Rasengan practice stops. Missions fall behind. Suddenly the village discovers its entire productivity plan was one exhausted teenager.
segments.label: TRAINING IS NOW DELAYED

segments.text: Kakashi looks up from his book. My guy has never seen a meeting this aggressively orange before.
segments.label: MANAGEMENT HAS LOGGED OFF

segments.text: The clones explain their real complaint: every painful training memory comes back to Naruto. He's exploiting himself with extra steps.
segments.label: MEMORIES COME BACK TOO

segments.text: So he proposes shorter rotations and actual breaks. Look at that. Character development with a lunch schedule attached.
segments.label: AN ACTUAL CONCESSION

segments.text: Instead of flooding every problem with bodies, smaller clone squads test strategies and report what actually worked first.
segments.label: SMALLER SQUAD SMARTER PLAN

segments.text: That doesn't create free chakra. They still split his supply. This union negotiates breaks, not a physics refund.
segments.label: THEY STILL SHARE CHAKRA

segments.text: Now opponents face coordinated scouts and decoys instead of a thousand orange dudes arguing over who gets punched.
segments.label: THE ENEMY MEETS A TEAM

segments.text: One clone asks who elected the original leader. Mother father. The confidence just left his entire forehead.
segments.label: WHO APPROVED THE LEADER

segments.text: Naruto joins the strike. The clones cheer. Konoha's biggest labor dispute ends with everyone demanding ramen from the same wallet.
segments.label: THE BOSS JOINS THE PICKET
